sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Origin Sky.

sections.heading: Description
lines: Sky Field is a field effect exclusive to Rejuvenation. It is categorized as an Elemental field and is used by Souta.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: Mountain, Snowy Mountain, and Volcanic Top Field will transform into this field if either Bounce or Fly is used.
“The battle was taken to the skies!”

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Flying-type moves increase in base power by 1.5x.
“The open air strengthened the attack!”
All weather effects last 8 turns.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Aerilate's damage boost is increased to 1.5x.
Big Pecks additionally boosts the bearer's Defense by 1 stage on switch-in.
“[Pokémon]'s Big Pecks raised its defense in the skies!”
Cloud Nine terminates weather effects instead of disabling them.
“[Pokémon]'s Cloud Nine removed all weather effects!”
Early Bird makes the bearer immune to Sleep.
Gale Wings is always active regardless of HP.
As of v13.5.6, this interaction is bugged and Gale Wings will not activate if the user is not at full HP.
Levitate, Lunar Idol, and Solar Idol additionally boost the bearer's Speed by 1 stage on switch-in.
“[Pokémon]'s [Ability] made it go faster in the open skies!”
As of v13.5.6, the field effect manual does not mention that Lunar Idol or Solar Idol boost Speed.
Long Reach additionally increases the bearer's damage by 1.5x and lets them deal super-effective damage to Flying-types.
Mimicry changes the user's type to Flying.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Moves that receive an attack buff:
Dive, Twister → 1.5x boost, Flying sub-typing.
“The open skies strengthened the attack!”

Aeroblast, Bleakwind Storm, Dragon Ascent, Dragon Darts, Esper Wing, Fairy Wind, Flying Press, Grav Apple, Icy Wind, Ominous Wind, Razor Wind, Silver Wind, Sky Uppercut, Steel Wing, Thunder, Thunderbolt, Thundershock → 1.5x boost.
“The open skies strengthened the attack!”
Sandsear Storm, Springtide Storm, Windbolt Storm → 1.3x boost.
“The open skies strengthened the attack!”
Moves that receive an attack nerf:
Bulldoze, Dig, Earthquake, Magnitude, Rototiller, Spikes, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes → Fail on use.
“But there is no solid ground!”
Other moves:
Bonemerang now deals super-effective damage to Flying-types.
Bounce, Fly, Razor Wind, and Sky Attack only last 1 turn.
Flying Press' Flying-type damage does not account for resistances.
Hurricane and Thunder never miss.
Mirror Move additionally boosts the user's Attack, Special Attack and Speed by 1 stage.
Tailwind lasts 8 turns and creates Strong Winds.
Weather Ball becomes Flying-type during Strong Winds.
Field-dependent moves:
Camouflage changes the user's type to Flying.
Nature Power becomes Sky Attack.
Secret Power may Confuse.
Shelter halves damage from Flying-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Flying.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost if it changes the field, unless noted otherwise.
This field will transform into Mountain if one of the moves Grav Apple, Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows is used.
“The battle has been brought down to the mountains!”

sections.heading: Items
lines: Elemental Seed boosts Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
